QF.id: SIA Case Studies on SAS Standards_42

question.text: An SE reports outcomes from a land restoration programme. The SIA's materiality and overclaiming assessment should focus on:

answer.text: Whether the CEO will be upset
Whether the news media will notice
Whether the reported outcomes are material (using quantitative and qualitative factors), whether sufficient evidence supports them, and whether deadweight has been considered to avoid overclaiming

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook supports assessing materiality using quantitative and qualitative factors, ensuring sufficient evidence, validating against baseline or benchmark data, and considering deadweight to avoid overclaiming. These are the core lenses the SIA applies. The Trap: CEO sentiment, media reaction and photo aesthetics are not audit considerations. Note: Disclose how materiality, evidence sufficiency and deadweight were applied so users can evaluate the assessor's conclusion.
